snippet.title: Just Dying - Official Trailer | Streamer Survivors Roguelite
snippet.description:
Wishlist Just Dying on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4646190/Just_Dying/
Free demo out now. Full release: November 4, 2026.

Just Dying is a fast-paced survivor roguelite starring peculiar streamers. Fight through hordes of everything content creators hate, build degenerate combos, and die anyway. Short runs, offline-first permanent progression.

DIE. LEARN. DIE BETTER.

- 16+ weapons and 30+ runes for builds that should not work: Toxic Chat, Hype Cannon, Ban Hammer
- Unlockable streamers with their own scaling rules and signature weapons
- The Atlas: unlock passives to break your future runs, but every point raises the difficulty
- Boss encounters with telegraphed mechanics and real patterns: skill and movement, 

Developed by Toloko Games, a solo indie studio.

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4646190/Just_Dying/
Free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4656170/

Discord:
https://discord.gg/mkYyJf2YMX

#JustDying #Roguelite #BulletHeaven
